label: adds-enum-request-history-reasons-issuing
content:
# Adds new enum values for request history reasons

## What’s new

Adds new values to the [Issuing Authorization](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/authorizations/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20) `request_history.reason` enum:

- `card_canceled`
- `card_expired`
- `cardholder_blocked`
- `insecure_authorization_method`
- `pin_blocked`

## Impact

Adds new values to the [request_history.reason](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/authorizations/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20#issuing_authorization_object-request_history-reason) property for the [Issuing Authorization](https://docs.stripe.com/api/issuing/authorizations/object.md?api-version=2024-06-20) resource. You can now more precisely track and understand why specific authorization requests were made

## Upgrade

#### REST API

1. [View your current API version](https://docs.stripe.com/workbench/guides.md#view-api-versions) in Workbench.
2. If you use an SDK, upgrade to the corresponding SDK version for this API version.
- If you don’t use an SDK, update your [API requests](https://docs.stripe.com/api-versions.md#how-versions-are-specified-in-requests) to include `Stripe-Version: 2024-06-20`
3. Upgrade the API version used for [webhook endpoints](https://docs.stripe.com/webhooks/versioning.md).
4. [Test your integration](https://docs.stripe.com/testing.md) against the new version.
5. If you use Connect, [test your Connect integration](https://docs.stripe.com/connect/testing.md).

Learn more about [Stripe API upgrades](https://docs.stripe.com/upgrades.md).
